{{Youmay|an [[in-universe]] storage device|[[Databank (2014-)|the official online encyclopedia]] or the [[Databank (original)|previous version of it]]|linebreak=1}}
[[File:Willrow-hood.jpg|thumb|250px|[[Willrow Hood/Legends|Willrow Hood]] holding a [[Computer/Legends|computer]] memory core.]]
A '''databank''', or '''database''', was an electronic storage terminal for data in [[Computer/Legends|computers]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] version, a [[Memory bank/Legends|memory bank]], was sometimes also called a databank.
